name: Hybrid Hair/Fur Rendering Strategy
aliases: Hybrid Hair/Fur Rendering with Volumetric Multiple Scattering Approximation
Volumetric Approximation for Hair/Fur Multiple Scattering
definition: A rendering algorithm that combines explicit surface-based light transport on hair geometry with restricted volumetric transport in an equivalent medium, explicitly sampling a limited set of light paths while approximating higher-order volumetric scattering statistically.
summary: This strategy renders hair by combining explicit geometry for direct light with a volumetric medium for multiple scattering, preserving strand details while efficiently simulating soft glow.
